I replied to Pree in her #central-team thread to confirm the correction: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23. She said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

Her earlier Dock 23 message is still in the channel, and so is my thread reply confirming it. Gate 47 is now the correct site.
